maya: quick note 
sketching a tiny checklist to validate speculative decode on new quant builds. want quick sanity check before i write a runbook.

jon: drop it here. main worries: metric choice and seed handling.

maya: checklist draft:
1) pick primary metric per workload (EM for QA, token-F1 for summarization).
2) matrix runs for builds: fp16 / int8-static / int8-dynamic / qkv-tail.
3) paired replay: control (spec=false) vs experiment (spec=true) with same ordered requests and seeds.
4) warmup 200 prompts, measure next 2000 requests.
5) collect: raw outputs, per-token logprobs, p50/p95 latency, fallback events, GPU traces.
6) stats: paired bootstrap for quality deltas, wilcoxon for latency tails, BH across task families.
7) acceptance: fail if primary metric drops >0.5pp and p<0.05 or hallucination rate +1ppt.

ravi: add calibration checks (ECE + token-confidence histograms).

sophie: ops: add automatic abort if fallback rate >2% or p95 >=2x baseline. alert to #eng-oncall.

maya: noted. i'll write the orchestration YAML and a minimal curl example, then open a PR with the runbook. tagging you all for review. :pray:
